purpose: Pin shared acceptance, tie, missing-label, coverage, and empirical risk-bound semantics across the CRISPR selective-risk and Broca retrieval evaluators. Domain adapters must map their own preregistered failure event to failure=true; this fixture does not equate domain labels or safety stakes.

contract.acceptance_rule: accept case iff acceptance_score >= inclusive threshold
contract.tie_rule: all cases with exactly equal canonical score enter together; never split a tie by row order
contract.coverage_denominator: all cases in the declared evaluation universe
contract.labelled_coverage_denominator: all cases in the declared evaluation universe
contract.observed_label_risk: known failures among accepted cases divided by known-labelled accepted cases; null if that denominator is zero
contract.optimistic_empirical_risk: known failures divided by all accepted cases, assigning every unknown accepted outcome to non-failure; null if no cases are accepted
contract.pessimistic_empirical_risk: (known failures + unknown accepted cases) divided by all accepted cases; null if no cases are accepted
contract.accepted_label_completeness: known-labelled accepted cases divided by all accepted cases; null if no cases are accepted
contract.unknown_labels: never silently convert unknown outcomes to safe or negative; unknown accepted outcomes block statistical certification
contract.zero_coverage: report an explicit zero-coverage origin with all counts zero and undefined rates null
contract.statistical_boundary: optimistic/pessimistic empirical rates are partial-label identification bounds, not confidence intervals. They do not correct selection bias or establish arbitrary-shift guarantees.

required_negative_controls: Reordering input rows must not change the curve.
The two score=0.7 cases must enter in a single tier.
Removing q4's label must widen the final empirical risk bounds rather than mark q4 safe.
A domain adapter that drops q4 or maps unknown to negative must fail the fixture.
The zero-coverage origin must be present even when a domain-specific legacy curve omits it.
A partial-label bound must never be labelled a confidence interval or a certification.

domain_adapter_notes.crispr: Convert each observed positive/assay-defined-negative label and the frozen binary decision (probability_positive > 0.5) into a classification-failure outcome; unknown remains unknown. This conversion is specific to the classification-risk endpoint.
domain_adapter_notes.broca: Supply the retrieval evaluator's preregistered unsafe-result outcome directly. Do not infer retrieval safety from a semantic-positive/negative label or from acceptance score alone.
domain_adapter_notes.consolidation: Share the metric contract and fixture before moving code into a common crate. Keep event definition, calibration semantics, sampling unit, context partitioning, and deployment authority domain-specific.
